content.scenarioBrief: A junior analyst asks their manager for a two-day extension on a quarterly report due on Friday.

scriptedUserTurns: I'm still working on the quarterly report and I'm a little concerned about Friday. Could I have two more days, please?
The sales figures haven't come through yet and I still need to write the summary. I could get the headline figures over to you on Friday and send the full draft on Monday.
Would Monday afternoon suit you? I want to make sure the board pack is not held up.
Thank you. I'll get the headline figures to you by Friday midday and the final draft on Monday.
recordedPersonaTurns: Morning. How is the quarterly report coming along?
Two more days is more than I anticipated. What is still outstanding?
Send the headline figures on Friday and the full draft on Monday afternoon. That should work.
Understood. I will make sure the board pack is not held up. Friday midday for the figures.
Agreed. Friday midday for the figures, Monday afternoon for the final draft.
